assessments.rationale: Using recycled aluminum minimizes the release of microplastics and nanoplastics during the manufacturing, machining, and finishing processes, directly addressing parameter (p) (Page 80). Additionally, processing recycled aluminum reduces the overall environmental footprint of manufacturing (m) and the consumption of energy and resources (g) compared to producing virgin plastics or complex fiber-reinforced composites (Page 33, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (due to increased weight of the tool affecting ergonomics) and Design stage (higher material cost and different thermal conductivity properties).

assessments.rationale: Threaded fasteners avoid the use of chemical adhesives, which release volatile organic compounds and other emissions to air, water, or soil (q) during the assembly and curing processes, and generate hazardous chemical waste (r) in the production facility (Page 80). This supports the zero-pollution ambition in manufacturing (Page 3).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Assembly line efficiency (increased assembly time and complexity compared to automated adhesive bonding) and potentially the Design stage (more individual parts to manage).

assessments.rationale: Manufacturing brushed DC motors is less resource-intensive and avoids the complex semiconductor fabrication required for brushless motor electronic controllers. This minimizes energy and water consumption in production (g), reduces the manufacturing environmental footprint (m), and limits emissions and hazardous waste (q, r) associated with PCB manufacturing (Page 33, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (brushless motors are more energy-efficient, durable, and require less maintenance, reducing the overall lifecycle energy footprint).

assessments.rationale: Passive cooling eliminates the need to manufacture an additional active fan component, thereby reducing resource and energy consumption in production (g) and preventing the generation of extra plastic and electronic waste (r) during manufacturing (Page 80). It also avoids potential microplastic and nanoplastic release (p) during fan blade fabrication (Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (active cooling prevents thermal degradation and allows for continuous high-performance operation, extending the tool's operational lifespan).

assessments.rationale: A monolithic integrated design is highly optimized for automated, high-volume manufacturing, which significantly reduces energy and resource consumption in production (g), minimizes the generation of manufacturing waste (r), and lowers the overall carbon and environmental footprint of the production process (m) (Page 33, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Repairability and End-of-Life stages (monolithic designs are extremely difficult to disassemble, repair, or recycle, directly conflicting with circular economy goals).

assessments.rationale: A corded power supply completely avoids the manufacturing of lithium-ion battery cells, which are highly energy- and water-intensive to produce (g), generate substantial hazardous waste (r), and release significant emissions to air, water, and soil (q) during raw material extraction and chemical processing (Page 3, Page 80).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Use stage (directly conflicts with the product's core definition as a 'cordless' screwdriver, severely limiting user mobility and convenience).
